name: Atlassian
summary: A clean enterprise software style with white and cloud surfaces, navy text, Atlassian blue CTAs, bright secondary system colors, rounded cards, product screenshots, integration grids, workflow diagrams, and restrained confetti-style accents.

layout.model: white and cloud SaaS sections with nav, hero, product screenshot, integration bands, feature grids, workflow diagrams, customer proof, and structured footer

elevation.shadows: soft and sparing on product screenshots and floating panels
elevation.gradients: subtle blue or pale surface gradients only when supporting product storytelling
elevation.depth: rounded cards, borders, screenshots, and layered illustration accents

dos: Use Atlassian Blue for the most important actions and active states.
Use white and cloud surfaces for clarity.
Use rounded cards, product screenshots, tabs, and integration grids.
Use bright secondary colors for status, charts, icons, and small accents.
Keep copy direct, helpful, and enterprise-friendly.
Use confetti shapes sparingly around brand moments.
donts: Do not use dark luxury palettes.
Do not make the UI overly playful or toy-like.
Do not add heavy glassmorphism or decorative blobs.
Do not use serif editorial typography.
Do not overuse every secondary color at once.
Do not make marketing sections look like dense admin dashboards.
